## About This Portfolio

This portfolio showcases my work in applying visual analytics methods using **R**, **ggplot2**, **Quarto**, and related tools. Across the course, I explore different ways to visualise data, communicate insights, and design more effective visualisations.

```{r, echo=FALSE}
pacman::p_load(tidyverse, yaml, knitr, dplyr, purrr)

`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x)) y else x

files <- list.files(".", pattern = "\\.qmd$", recursive = TRUE, full.names = TRUE)

get_meta <- function(path) {
  lines <- readLines(path, warn = FALSE)
  if (length(lines) < 3 || lines[1] != "---") return(NULL)
  
  end <- which(lines[-1] == "---")[1] + 1
  if (is.na(end)) return(NULL)
  
  yml_text <- paste(lines[2:(end - 1)], collapse = "\n")
  meta <- yaml::yaml.load(yml_text)
  
  date_raw <- meta$date %||% NA_character_
  
  date_parsed <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(date_raw, format = "%Y-%m-%d"))
  
  if (is.na(date_parsed)) {
    date_parsed <- suppressWarnings(as.Date(date_raw, format = "%B %d, %Y"))
  }
  
  if (is.na(date_parsed)) {
    date_parsed <- suppressWarnings(
      as.Date(gsub("\\.", "", date_raw), format = "%B %d %Y")
    )
  }
  
  tibble(
    path = path,
    href = sub("\\.qmd$", ".html", path),
    title = meta$title %||% basename(path),
    date = date_parsed
  )
}

latest <- purrr::map_dfr(files, get_meta) %>%
  tidyr::drop_na(date) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(date)) %>%
  dplyr::slice_head(n = 3)
```

    "</div>",
    sep = ""
  )
}
